title: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Car Detailing
h1: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Car Detailing
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for pressure washers for car detailing, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pressure washers for car detailing using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: AR Blue Clean AR383 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1900 PSI, 1.51 GPM, Bayonet-connect nozzles and accessories, Onboard detergent tank.
strengths: 1900 PSI sits right at the safe upper end for car exteriors without needing to dial anything down
Compact enough to store in a garage corner between washes, unlike bulkier driveway-focused units
Budget price makes it an easy first pressure washer if car washing is the main use case
limitations: 1.51 GPM rinses a full-size vehicle a bit slower than higher-flow units
Bayonet connectors are a less common fitting standard than quick-connect, worth checking foam cannon compatibility before buying one
Lower build durability rating than the Karcher K5 over years of frequent use

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3000 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2030 max PSI, 1.76 GPM max flow, Dual detergent tanks, 5 quick-connect nozzles including a 40-degree wide fan.
strengths: Standard quick-connect fitting works with the widest range of aftermarket foam cannons and car-wash attachments
Dual detergent tanks let you keep a dedicated car soap loaded separately from an all-purpose cleaner
Widest nozzle selection in this list for dialing in a safe, wide fan spread
limitations: 2030 PSI is more than a car needs, requires consistent nozzle and distance discipline
Bulkier than the AR Blue Clean AR383 for a single-purpose car-washing setup
No car-specific preset or reduced-pressure mode
features: 5 quick-connect nozzles including a 40-degree wide fan
Standard quick-connect fitting, compatible with most foam cannons

products.name: Greenworks GPW1501 1500 PSI Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500 max PSI, 1.2 GPM, Upright hand-carry design, Turbo nozzle included.
strengths: 1500 PSI ceiling means there's very little risk of overdoing it on paint even at closer range
Lightest and most compact unit in this list, easy to carry around a vehicle without a cart
Fits easily in a trunk for washing a car away from home, like at a family member's driveway
limitations: 1.2 GPM is the slowest rinse rate of the three picks here
No included wide fan nozzle specifically suited to paint, relies on turbo nozzle used at distance
Underpowered for anything beyond cars and small household jobs
